utility.name: AI lab student workspace
utility.author: Thomas Shaw
utility.description: Puts an AI security lab's notebook and data (pool_size images, or the same number of labelled examples) in each account's ~/lab, adds a JupyterLab launcher, and installs the script Hackerbot uses to run a student's model as that student. Based on material from the CyBOK-funded Security-of-AI project (Anglia Ruskin University). Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
